title: Tausret
summary: King listed in CFAH-9 Table 2 (Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-9 (Table 2, "Integrated Chronology of Dynasties 19 and 26"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Rgn: 7/50; BC Dates: 484 - 475 - 434?). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-11: Dynasties 20 and 21," OSF preprint v1.3 (17 Nov 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/KSAZ9, file CFAH-11_v1.3.pdf, Table 1 "Proposed Dynasty 20 Rulers and Reigns", p. 22
reign.note: Row "Tausret (D19) = Thuoris" of Table 1 (Egypt Dynasties 19–20 and their CFAH alter egos (Dynasties 28–30)).

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-9: The 19th and 26th Dynasties of Egypt," OSF preprint v1.4 (25 Sep 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/HV3B2, file CFAH-9_Dynasties_19_and_26_v1.4.pdf, Table 2 "Integrated Chronology of Dynasties 19 and 26", p. 58
reign.note: Row "Tausret & Siptah (son)" of Table 2 (Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26). The row is printed "Tausret & Siptah (son)".
